description: Live weather for any place on earth, including the radar echo drawn as text characters rather than an image: current conditions and air quality, a short forecast, a 2-hour rain sparkline, a character radar map with the measured motion of the echo, and the next 24 hours and 5 days. The reply also links the same weather as a phone-width picture, for showing a person.

lang.description: Language of the reply. Default en.

place.description: Place name (any language) or 'lon,lat' with longitude first, e.g. tokyo, 清迈, or 139.7,35.7

name: get_weather
title: Weather scene with a text radar map
